name: Park Hyatt Saigon
positioning: French colonial-style hotel on Lam Son Square in central Ho Chi Minh City, beside the Saigon Opera House; Hyatt's first hotel in Vietnam, opened in 2005
best_for: Travelers who want a central base within walking distance of the Opera House, the Central Post Office and Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica
Food lovers interested in French-Vietnamese fine dining at Square One and Italian cooking at Opera
Guests interested in the hotel's history and its collection of Vietnamese art

facts.text: The hotel is on Lam Son Square, a short walk from the Saigon Opera House, the Central Post Office and Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica of Saigon.
The hotel's 2005 debut marked Hyatt's first foray in Vietnam.
The French colonial building has an ivory-colored facade that matches the Saigon Opera House next door.
Black-and-white photographs and lacquer paintings by Vietnamese artists hang on the walls, courtesy of Ben Thanh Art Gallery.
The suites have a separate living room and a curated collection of oil paintings, antiques, lacquerware and handcrafted embroidery by established Vietnamese artists.
Park Deluxe rooms have a private terrace with direct access to the pool and garden.
Square One is the hotel's signature restaurant, combining French gastronomy with Vietnamese flavours.
Opera, guided by Chef Luca Cappellato, serves Italian cooking.
M Lounge showcases a selection of Macallan whisky expressions.
Xuan Spa uses Mekong Delta essences such as fresh herbs, local grains and fruits.
An hour-long art tour on weekends showcases the hotel's most prized pieces.
A complimentary Chocolaterie tour on weekdays shows how the artisanal treats are made.

highlights.text: The hotel stands on the former site of the Brinks Hotel Officers' Quarters, where US military officials lived during the Vietnam War.
Square One received MICHELIN Guide recognition in 2023, 2024 and 2025.
Square One has two open-concept kitchens, one for Vietnamese dishes and one for French brasserie classics.
The Magic Table is a dining experience led by Thommy Ten and Amelie van Tass, known as The Clairvoyants, using 3D projection mapping.
Park Lounge serves afternoon tea from the Ercuis trolley and offers a Dom Perignon tasting.

considerations.text: There is no lifeguard at the pool, and children must be accompanied by an adult at all times.
Tan Son Nhat International Airport is 7 kilometers from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes a busy urban location with city noise.
